zones and rates

FedEx Ground Economy Media zones 1
FedEx Ground Economy Media rates 2–3
1 fedex.com 1.800.GoFedEx 1.800.463.3339
Determine FedEx Ground
Economy Media rates
1. Find the zone for your destination
in the zone table.
2. Determine your total shipment weight
(round up to the next-higher pound).
3. Using the rate table, find applicable
rate where zone and weight meet.
FedEx Ground® Economy Media zones
Zone(s) Description
2–8 Determining your delivery zone: For contiguous U.S.
shipments, go to fedex.com/ratetools/RateT oolsMain.do,
then enter your origin ZIP code to see which zone your
destination ZIP code corresponds to.1
26 (Z) All other non-contiguous U.S., including American Samoa,
Federated States of Micronesia, Guam, Marshall Islands,
Northern Mariana Islands, Palau, and U.S. Virgin Islands
[excluding 17 (A), 9 (H), 99 (M), and 10 (P)]
17 (A) Alaska
9 (H) Hawaii
99 (M) Military (APO/FPO)
10 (P) Puerto Rico
1ZIP code and zone alignments are subject to change without notice.

FedEx Ground Economy Media standard list rates
FedEx Ground® Economy Media rates
Use these rates when shipping media packages within the U.S. To determine the applicable zone for your shipment, go
to fedex.com/ratetools/RateToolsMain.do and enter your origin ZIP code and destination ZIP code.1
1ZIP code and zone alignments are subject to change without notice.
This service is provided on a contract-only basis.

FedEx Ground Economy Media standard list rates
FedEx Ground® Economy Media rates
1 ZIP code and zone alignments are subject to change without notice.
2 Per-pound rates will apply for packages rated above 70 lbs. The shipping charges for a FedEx Ground Economy oversize package will be based on the greatest of the package’s actual rounded weight,
dimensional weight, and 71 lbs.
This service is provided on a contract-only basis.
Refer to the Fees and Other Shipping Information document for a list of surcharges.
Use these rates when shipping media packages within the U.S. To determine the applicable zone for your shipment, go
to fedex.com/ratetools/RateToolsMain.do and enter your origin ZIP code and destination ZIP code.1
